issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 65,702.30 (worksheet p4: General 40,006.38 + Sinking 25,695.92)
issues.issue: Unlabeled local receipts are 40% of receipts; nothing on the form says what they are (for a fire district they may be rural fire contracts or donations). 'other' with review is defensible, but this fund type exceeds the 10% other threshold.
